# opalstack_osvar (Resource)

An environment variable of shell users. It is given to the shell users in `osuser_ids`, or to every shell user of the account when `global` is set.

The name of a variable does not have to be unique: the API accepts a second variable of the same name for the same shell user. The API returns the content on every read, and it is stored in the Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_osuser" "web" {
  name = "example_user"
}

resource "opalstack_osvar" "node_env" {
  name       = "NODE_ENV"
  content    = "production"
  osuser_ids = [data.opalstack_osuser.web.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the variable: letters, digits, `_`, `+` and `-`, at most 128 characters. Changing it replaces the variable.

### Optional

- `content` (String, Sensitive) Value of the variable, at most 1024 characters. White space around it is not shown as a change. Left out, a new variable is empty and an existing one keeps the value the API has.
- `global` (Boolean) Whether the variable is given to every shell user of the account, present and future. Left out, a new variable is not global and an existing one stays as the API has it. This has not been verified against the live API, and the provider refuses it while `safety_prefix` is set.
- `osuser_ids` (Set of String) UUIDs of the shell users the variable is given to. It may be empty: the variable then belongs to nobody. Left out, the list is empty on a new object and is left as it is on an existing one.
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the variable.

<a id="nestedatt--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By UUID, or by name when only one variable has that name.
terraform import opalstack_osvar.node_env 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
terraform import opalstack_osvar.node_env NODE_ENV
```
